harness_artifacts.note: Self-inflicted: agent called WBListora\Search\Facets::taxonomy_facets() (private static) via wp-cli eval without ReflectionMethod::setAccessible() while investigating D.search-empty-candidate-set. Runs entirely through the wp-cli.phar boot chain, unreachable from any request. Re-run correctly via reflection immediately after with zero DB errors on the real call. Preserved as evidence, not a product defect.

Self-inflicted: agent's first attempt at seeding a photo-review for D.detail-tab-review-hooks used a raw $wpdb->insert() into wp_listora_reviews with a (user_id, listing_id) pair that already existed, tripping the idx_user_listing unique index — the index doing its job, not a bug. Abandoned in favor of the real POST /listora/v1/listings/{id}/reviews REST path, which is what the D row was actually verified against.

manual_required: F.firefox-desktop — Chromium-only Playwright cannot exercise: Business Hours flatpickr open-on-click (D.business-hours-firefox), listing-map popup image render, dashboard 768px breakpoint, search autocomplete keyboard nav.
F.safari-ios — sticky bottom CTA bar vs admin bar overlap, submission wizard step-transition viewport jumps, map-popup tap targets >=40px.
notes: F.rtl failed during the walk (buddyx-pro-rtl.css 404 on RTL locales), was fixed in Free a5b7ea3, and was re-verified in-browser at dir=rtl lang=ar: zero 404s, every genuine RTL twin still 200. Counted as a pass because that is the state of the code being released.

harness_artifacts holds two debug.log entries caused by the QA harness itself (a wp eval reflection call to a private method, and a raw INSERT hitting the reviews unique index). Both traced entirely through the wp-cli.phar boot chain and are unreachable from any HTTP request; the duplicate-key one is the unique index working correctly. Preserved rather than deleted.
